title: Restricted children retain operating system startup facts
when: A delegated Python command or isolated test child starts on native Windows.
need: A restricted child retains SYSTEMROOT, SYSTEMDRIVE, WINDIR, COMSPEC and PATHEXT when present so Python networking can initialize. Test executable paths use the native path separator; disposable home and app-data paths stay separate from caller authority.
surface: Delegated service-client environment and isolated test-support builders.
review: Focused child-environment checks cover OS variable preservation and secret isolation; the Windows suite exercises release-all and the product-boundary commands without weakening their assertions.
